newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER SHOWCASE-LIVERPOOL'S FOWLER LOSES FITNESS BATTLE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER SHOWCASE-LIVERPOOL'S FOWLER LOSES FITNESS BATTLE.

text.p: Liverpool striker Robbie Fowler has lost his fight to shake off a knee injury ahead of Saturday's big premier league clash with Manchester United.

The 21-year-old, who scored twice in the corresponding fixture at Old Trafford last season, has been sidelined for a fortnight and had to pull out of the England squad for their World Cup match against Poland on Wednesday.
Stan Collymore is expected to play as a lone striker for Liverpool, supported by Czech international Patrik Berger.
England call-up Dominic Matteo has recovered from his knee injury and will play in place of defender Neil Ruddock.
United manager Alex Ferguson has virtually his entire squad to choose from for the morning match between the defending champions and the current league leaders.
Irish midfielder Roy Keane and striker Andy Cole are absent with long-term injuries, but otherwise, United are at full strength.

Norwegian Ole Gunnar Solskjaer, who scored both United's goals in their last match against Tottenham, is fit to play despite being substituted with an injury during Norway's midweek World Cup win over Hungary.
